title: Administrator
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an organised and proactive Depot Administrator to join a busy operational team based in York.

This role is ideal for an experienced administrator who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, providing essential administrative and reception support to ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of the depot. You will work closely with operational teams, maintaining accurate records, coordinating administrative activities and acting as the first point of contact for visitors and telephone enquiries.

This is a varied role that offers the opportunity to become an integral part of a professional and collaborative team.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide comprehensive administrative support to the depot and operational teams.
- Maintain accurate electronic and paper-based records.
- Perform data entry and ensure company systems are kept up to date.
- Produce reports and maintain departmental spreadsheets.
- Record annual leave, overtime and employee absence records.
- Coordinate training bookings and maintain training records.
- Raise purchase orders for PPE, tools and general depot requirements.
- Process employee expenses in accordance with company procedures.
- Answer incoming telephone calls and respond to email enquiries professionally.
- Welcome visitors and provide front-of-house reception support.
- Manage incoming and outgoing post.
- Arrange taxis and other travel requirements.
- Book meeting rooms and coordinate site meetings.
- Order stationery and office supplies.
- Support the wider business with additional administrative duties as required.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an Administration, Office Administrator, Receptionist or Business Support role.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong attention to detail and high levels of accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Professional and approachable manner.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Flexible approach with a willingness to support the wider business when required.

Desirable Skills
- Experience raising purchase orders.
- Experience processing employee expenses.
- Previous experience within an engineering, manufacturing, rail or industrial environment.
- Experience maintaining personnel or training records.

Personal Attributes
- Organised and methodical.
- Reliable and dependable.
- Friendly and professional with excellent customer service skills.
- Proactive and able to use initiative.
- Positive attitude with a willingness to learn.
- Strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills.

Working Pattern
- Monday to Thursday.
- 8-hour shifts.
- 32 hours per week.
- Office-based role in York.
- Opportunity to work additional hours when required.

What's on Offer
- Initial 6-month rolling contract with the potential for extension.
- Comprehensive training on internal systems and processes.
- Supportive team environment.
- Opportunity to gain experience within a busy operational depot.
- Immediate start with handover available.

Apply Now

If you're an organised and motivated administrator looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to become part of a busy and supportive operational team where your organisational skills and attention to detail will make a real difference.

title: Depot Administrator
description:
Depot Administrator

Location: York
Contract: 6-Month Rolling Contract
Hours: 08:00 - 16:00 Mon - Thu ( 32 hrs a week )
Pay Rate: 13.87 per hour PAYE

About the Role

We are looking for an organised and proactive Depot Administrator to join our team based at our York depot. This is a varied administrative position that combines office administration and reception duties, providing essential support to the depot and helping ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the site.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator who enjoys working in a busy environment and is comfortable managing multiple tasks while maintaining attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities
Administration
- Data entry and maintenance of company records and databases.
- Filing and document management.
- Producing reports and updating spreadsheets.
- Recording annual leave, overtime and Euroleave information.
- Booking employee training courses and maintaining training records.
- Raising purchase orders and processing expenses.
- Supporting the ordering and tracking of PPE, tools and other depot supplies.
- General administrative support to the depot management team.

Reception & Front of House
- Answering and directing incoming telephone calls.
- Managing shared email inboxes and responding to enquiries.
- Greeting visitors and ensuring appropriate site sign-in procedures are followed.
- Logging incoming and outgoing post.
- Arranging taxis and travel requirements when needed.
- Booking meeting rooms and coordinating meeting arrangements.
- Ordering stationery and maintaining office supplies.

Skills & Experience
Essential
- Previous experience in an administrative and/or receptionist role.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Ability to prioritise workload and manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Reliable, professional and customer-focused approach.

Desirable
- Experience raising purchase orders and processing expenses.
- Experience maintaining staff records, training records or leave trackers.
- Experience working within an operational, depot or logistics environment.

Additional Information
- This is a site-based role, working four days per week from the York depot.
- Standard compliance checks will apply.
- Training will be provided for specific processes, including overtime and Euroleave recording.
- Flexibility to work additional hours when required would be advantageous.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be a friendly, approachable and highly organised administrator who enjoys supporting a busy team. title: HR Administrator
description:
Keeping the employee journey running smoothly takes more than paperwork - it takes accurate processes, reliable systems and someone who makes sure nothing gets missed. title: Invoicing Administrator

description:
Invoicing Assistant for an 18th month contract

Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm

Own transport essential due to location

Are you organised, switched-on and great with people? Do you love getting things done, enjoy working as part of a team and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves when things get busy?

Then this could be the role for you!

We're looking for a positive and enthusiastic Accounts Administrator to join our busy team. You'll be a key part of the operation, making sure invoices are accurate, queries are resolved and everything keeps moving at pace.

What Will You Be Doing?

- Preparing invoices using our bespoke internal system.
- Handling invoicing queries via telephone and email.
- Building great relationships with customers and clients while dealing with claims and invoicing queries.

- Supporting colleagues across the site and jumping in wherever you're needed.

It's All About Attitude!

We're looking for someone who brings energy, enthusiasm and a genuine can-do attitude.

You'll be someone who:
- Gets stuck in and doesn't wait to be asked.
- Enjoys working as part of a busy, friendly team.
- Is flexible and happy to help wherever needed.
- Has excellent attention to detail.
- Is confident speaking to customers and colleagues.
- Can manage their workload and stay organised when things get busy.
- Takes pride in getting things right.
- Is approachable, positive and - importantly - knows how to have a laugh along the way!

Experience in accounts, invoicing, administration, or claims would be a bonus, but it's your attitude, reliability and willingness to learn that really matter.

What's In It For You?

We want our people to enjoy coming to work, and we offer a great benefits package to help make that happen:

25 Days Holiday

Enjoy a generous holiday allowance and make the most of your time away from work.

UK Health

Access to a contributory healthcare scheme, with the option to increase your cover to suit your personal and family needs.

Enjoy access to discounted shopping and meal vouchers, plus webinars and exercise classes.

Access an online GP service whenever you need it.

You'll be enrolled into the company pension scheme to help you plan for the future.

Ready to Get Moving?

If you're looking for a role where you can learn, contribute, have fun and become part of a team that genuinely helps each other, we'd love to hear from you.

Whether you're already experienced in invoicing and accounts or you're looking for your next opportunity and have the right attitude, we want to hear from you!

Would you like to join a growing financial services business in Pickering, where you ll be trusted to manage your own workload, build relationships with clients and develop your knowledge along the way?

We are looking for an organised and personable Office Administrator to join our client s friendly, open-plan office.

This is a permanent opportunity offering plenty of variety. You ll be working with different systems, communicating regularly with clients and supporting the team with the administration needed to keep client records accurate, compliant and up to date.

You don t need to know everything about the industry day one. What s important is that you re proactive, confident communicating with people and comfortable taking ownership of your work. You ll provide day-to-day administrative support to the team while helping to ensure clients receive an efficient and professional service.
- Completing and processing client forms and documentation.
- Contacting clients to chase outstanding information, documents and signatures.
- Ensuring the required documentation is received and recorded for compliance purposes.
- Keeping client information and records accurate and up to date.
- Using a number of different systems to manage information and administrative processes.
- Creating reports and letters from templates to send to clients.
- Communicating confidently with clients by telephone and email.

This role would suit someone who enjoys taking responsibility for their work rather than waiting to be given their next task.

Skills required

We re looking for someone who is organised, approachable and comfortable working in a busy environment. You ll ideally have:
- Previous administration experience is essential.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- A proactive approach and the confidence to use your own initiative.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence speaking with people over the phone.
- The ability to self-manage and prioritise a varied workload.
- Good IT skills and the ability to learn and work across several different systems.
- A professional approach when handling confidential information.

Other information
- Full time working 8:30am 5:00pm Monday to Thursday and 8:30am 1:30pm Friday

description: A unique and exciting fixed term opportunity (18 months) has arisen for an organised, conscientious and dynamic administrator to join our recently established Community Mental Health 'Hub' team. It forms part of York Mental Health Partnership's vision of support for adults across the city and will help change the way people are able to access mental health services. It is expected that the post holder will, as required by the service, work 'in the field' on occasion i.e. at the CYC building or events nearby. These locations and facilities will be easily accessible by car, bus and bicycle. As a member of this small and friendly multi-disciplinary team, you will work in both an office environment and alongside the team in the community. You must have the Right to Work in the UK in order to be successfully appointed to this role. Please note, this role does not meet the required eligibility criteria for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker visa and therefore the Trust is unable to offer sponsorship for this particular role. Having significant previous experience as an administrator is essential to this role. NHS or other health/social care experience is desirable. We are looking for an individual with a passion for people, demonstrable customer service experience, extensive organisational skills, an interest in working in a mental health care setting and a 'can do' attitude. This role will be the heart of a dedicated and caring team and is a pivotal role in the day-to-day operations. You will provide essential day-to-day administrative support to the clinical team, ensuring that the processes you develop and put in place are sustainable and meet the needs of the service. This will enable them to provide the best possible care for the service users. We are looking for someone who feels comfortable in a public healthcare setting, can multi-task in a busy environment, can communicate confidently, is thorough and takes pride in their work, can build strong working relationships with a variety of people, can prioritise their workload and work to deadlines. With a starting salary of £25,760 per annum, a generous NHS pension scheme, a fantastic annual leave package (27 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays) and access to other NHS staff benefits and discounts, it is fair to say that this job has a lot to offer. And, its not just the NHS pay scale and benefits that we offer that make joining our organisation an excellent choice, there are many training and development opportunities available, giving you the opportunity for career progression. All staff have regular 1-2-1s, quarterly supervision meetings and an annual appraisal, which provides lots of opportunity for discussion around achievements, challenges and aspirations. Staff recognition is very important to us; we work closely with colleagues to support development, the staff voice, and to recognise teams and individuals through our Greatix and Star Award schemes; highlighting the outstanding work being done every day. We recognise that Administrators are professionals and are a valuable asset to our organisation. We understand that they have a key role in the support and delivery of our services and that their contribution helps us in achieving our aim of consistently providing safe and high-quality care for our service users. The kind of care we would want for ourselves and for our loved ones. title: Part-time Receptionist
description: We are a small GP Practice with a very high level of satisfaction among our patients thanks to the dedication and professionalism of all our staff. As a Receptionist you are the first point of entry into the practice and therefore key in maintaining our reputation and our standards, whether in person or on the phone. In this role you will be faced by varied and sometimes challenging tasks, occasionally having to deal with some uncomfortable situations. Your communication and listening skills will be critical for this. This is an exiting and satisfying role as part of a small but happy and committed team. Main duties include greeting and assisting everyone who contacts the practice whether in person or on the phone, making, cancelling and rescheduling appointments with the clinical staff. You are expected to work 10-15 hours per week at different times respecting the agreed rotas. You are flexible and are able to do additional hours on other days to cover holidays and sickness of your colleagues. No weekend work is involved. In addition to permanent patient contact to assist them and deal with their queries you will also have additional administrative tasks to fulfil such as patient registration, information updating, scanning documents , calling patients based on requests from the clinical staff for specific requirements, etc. Depending on your shift you will be required to open or close the practice and perform the daily checks and controls associated with those moments. Good communication and problem solving skills and ability to multitask are key requirements for this position Please DO NOT USE AI to complete your application. AI generated replies WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED This position is offered as a temporary contract but it may become permanent depending on circumstances. This is an on-site position. Working from home is not possible. ------------------------------------------------------------------ Job responsibilities: To deal politely and efficiently with patients as the first point of contact for anyone visiting or calling the surgery. Dealing with patients and visitors professionally, efficiently, with empathy and courtesy. To ensure patient confidentiality is respected at all times and to adhere to the Data Protection Act. Make routine and emergency appointments for patient to see the doctors and nurses. Check patient details on clinical system. Deal with requests for home visits. Answer queries with regard to results of recent tests e.g. bloods, urine or x-ray. This includes contacting the hospital(s) for these results if necessary. Inform patients, when directed by a doctor, of the need to make a follow-up appointment at the surgery. Accurate completion of registration forms ensuring the existing patient information is correct and up to date andupdating it based on patients requests. Accept requests for repeat prescriptions, hand out completed prescriptions, cancel appointments when necessary, contact the patients (s) and re-book if required. Book patient hospital transport when required. Contact the emergency services when necessary. Filing, scanning and organising medical notes. Assist in ordering and stock control of relevant stationery. Check and tidy consulting rooms between surgeries and keeping waiting area clean and in order. In the morning, open the surgery and ensure everything is ready for the upcoming session. In the afternoon, close the surgery and ensure everything is locked up properly and the alarm is set. Administrative Duties Scanning documents onto clinical system.Other administrative duties as required and agreed. Ensure that reception area is tidy and maintain cleanliness in the kitchen facilities when necessary. Be flexible in being available for overtime in order to cover for colleagues' leave and sickness. Ensure you read all the Practice mandatory policies and that you complete all the mandatory courses. Any other relevant duties as mutually agreed.
